"Workshop Inside the Canon" refers to the concept and academic publication proposing that canonical biblical texts are the ultimate, surviving products of ancient literary workshops rather than suppressed alternative writings.
It argues that the Logos prologue in John 1:1 serves as a compositional manifesto describing the incarnation of discourse into scripture.
You can explore the core arguments in the published paper via the Zenodo Record for The Workshop Inside the Canon.
